text:
Gina (PM): Quick thread: customers keep saying "can't find invoices" on the Usage page. Two options on the table: keep cards+chart, or move to a dense ledger with a clear invoice affordance. Opinions?
Leo (Design): Dense ledger is faster to scan. But agree the invoice CTA must be extremely discoverable — top-level primary CTA seems necessary.
Noah (Analytics): Data: when header invoice CTA is visible, downloads + support satisfaction both improve. If it's nested in rows, downloads drop ~25%.
Priya (Frontend): Implementation note: sticky header CTA is straightforward. Per-row CSV/PDF buttons are fine but we must avoid tab overload. Roving tabindex required.
Gina (PM): File format expectation: accounting teams want PDFs, engineers want CSVs. Suggest header primary = "Download invoice (PDF)" and per-row secondary = "Download usage (CSV)".
Leo (Design): Agree. Also propose a subtle metadata line under CTA: "Latest billed: May 2026" so users know what period the PDF covers.
Noah (Analytics): We'll track source + format. Tag events: invoice_download.header.pdf, invoice_download.row.csv. Want to see which becomes the default.
Priya (Frontend): Accessibility: scope switch must announce changes. I'll add an aria-live region: `aria-live="polite"` and make the scope control `role="group" aria-label="Billing scope"`.
a11y-bot: Reminder: segmented controls for token/USD need ARIA roles and 4.5:1 contrast. Provide non-color indicators for swatches.
Leo (Design): Token toggle copy: instead of "Token view" use "Display: Tokens / USD" and show small "Saved preference" microcopy when changed.
Gina (PM): Chart layout: small multiples vs single big timeseries. Any rule of thumb?
Noah (Analytics): Small multiples help compare 2-5 projects quickly. Beyond that, aggregate + per-project drilldown preferred. Recommend adaptive rule: <=5 -> multiples; >5 -> aggregate with legend.
Leo (Design): Visuals: sparklines column (48px) in ledger, muted grayscale with a colored focus state to match project swatch. Each mini-chart needs `aria-label` like "Project X — 30-day spend trend".
Priya (Frontend): Perf note: for long lists render sparklines in canvas or fetch pre-rendered SVGs server-side to avoid DOM bloat. Also lazy-render offscreen charts.
Gina (PM): Copy clarity: change generic CTAs like "Download" to explicit labels: "Download invoice (PDF)" and "Download usage (CSV)". Tests showed confusion otherwise.
Noah (Analytics): Also surface a tiny 'last invoice date' next to header CTA; it reduces "which period" support questions.
Priya (Frontend): Keyboard behavior: row actions reachable via single-tab then arrow keys to move between actions. I'll prototype a roving-tabindex pattern.
Leo (Design): Contrast/spacing: compact rows should use 8px vertical rhythm. Segmented control hit area min 44px. Focus outline: 3px solid brand-blue.
a11y-bot: Suggestion: add a "Skip to billing actions" link for quick keyboard access to the invoice CTA area.
Gina (PM): One more: should we remember user's last-view (ledger vs cards)? Power users flip back and forth.
Noah (Analytics): Persisting last-view per user reduces churn. We'll add telemetry and a retention metric.
Leo (Design): I'll update mocks: header CTA + metadata, compact ledger with sparklines, token toggle in header, per-row small CSV icon with tooltip "Download usage (CSV)", and accessibility annotations.
Priya (Frontend): Actionable plan: implement sticky header CTA, prototype roving tabindex, canvas sparklines for long lists, aria-live scope announcement.
Gina (PM): OK action list: Leo update Figma, Priya prototype interactions, Noah set up event tracking and experiment for default token vs USD, Gina update PRD copy. Quick review tomorrow 11am.
Leo (Design): Posting frames and notes soon. :zap:
Gina (PM): Thanks everyone, resolving for now.
